summary: Give authorized agent restart requests the explicit retry path and prompt refusal outcome

replay.detail: No canonical replay change or new replay trigger.

schema.detail: No schema digest, kind, field, table, index or migration changes. Existing actor-bound restart requests, attempts and completion receipts remain in use.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, rule digest or admission changes. Existing actor admission, declaration/incarnation, placement, rollout and suspension guards remain.

compatibility.detail: An authorized agent explicit restart can now spend the same one-shot retry as a person despite an automatic failed-start park. An unsuccessful attempt completes with the existing restart failure reason, which the CLI reports without waiting for its timeout. Automatic starts retain their park; replay or daemon restart grants no new attempt. The CLI/peer request and response shapes are unchanged. Older daemons retain the prior person-only retry behavior.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond ordinary binary deployment; validation uses isolated fake-runtime, Store and CLI fixtures.

manual.detail: After correcting setup, a granted agent may use agents restart with its own actor to retry a parked seat once. A still-broken setup reports its refusal and parks again; a separate authorized request permits another attempt. No wait budget increase, implicit declaration replacement, person impersonation or bypass of native provider admission.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback requires no data conversion. Existing operation deduplication and failure receipts remain authoritative.
